phase3_findings.description: The added test-file module-load bypass comment (test_python_scripts.py lines 21-25) spans five physical source lines and is largely provenance/derivation, exceeding the three-line prevention-only comment cap. Mitigating: it mirrors the pre-existing sibling three-verdict bypass comment style in the same file, so it is stylistic consistency rather than new noise.

_extension_row_verdict uses next(...) to locate a row, inspecting only the FIRST line matching a row substring. A workpad with a duplicated extension row (first ticked, later copy unticked) would pass the gate (fail-open on the duplicate). Unlikely input — rows are single-sourced through _EXTENSION_ROWS and reconciled — and untested. Low severity.

Note-detection matches any non-checkbox ## Progress line containing the row substring plus 'state not established'; it is not anchored to the sanctioned '- HH:MM:SS — …' note shape. A deliberate, documented design choice ('keyed on the row name plus that phrase, not a byte-exact match'); small blast radius. Informational.

No test proves a 'state not established' note placed OUTSIDE ## Progress fails to satisfy an unticked row (the gate reads only prog_content). Direction fails closed (safe); low-value mirror of the note-keying assertion.

No test asserts the ordering of _extension_row_verdict relative to the AC hard-fail when both are unticked (which refusal surfaces first). Not a correctness concern — both refuse Complete. Optional precedence documentation.

# PRFlow Review — PR #1943 (issue #1817)

**Verdict: APPROVE with notes**

## Diff classification
engine_self_modifying (touches skills/**, lib/**, scripts/**) → full Phase 1+2 checklist; Phase 3 roster gated by Phase 3.1 applicability. has_new_types=false (no new type declarations — _extension_row_verdict is a function), config_only=false (.py files), small_diff=false (222 insertions). detect_all_audit=false (the new gate iterates a fixed hand-listed tuple _EXTENSION_ROWS, not an enumerated population with a completeness assertion).

## Change under review
Adds `_extension_row_verdict(progress_content)` to scripts/workpad.py and calls it from `_terminal_complete_gate`, so a terminal `--status Complete` is refused while any `prompt extension resolved:` row is unticked and carries no `state not established` note (naming each offending row), mirroring the existing unticked-AC hard-fail. Updates skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md §1.3 prose to name the gate; adds a dedicated RED-first test block to lib/test/test_python_scripts.py (AC1–AC4, plural path, note-keying, legacy tolerance, direct pure-read invariants); adds a changeset.

## Phase 3 roster
Dispatched (5): code-reviewer, silent-failure-hunter, comment-analyzer, pr-test-analyzer (test-relevance predicate matches — test file modified), requesting-code-review final pass. type-design-analyzer skipped (has_new_types=false). Fix-loop iteration 1 → no iterations:first-only exclusion. All 5 returned; 0 failed agents.

## Findings
All findings are Suggestion-level; none Critical or Important; no `documented_falsehood` (the phase-1-setup.md 'Phase 4.3 terminal gate' claim and changeset claims verified true against HEAD by three agents independently).

1. (Suggestion, style) test_python_scripts.py:21-25 — added bypass comment is 5 lines of provenance, over the 3-line prevention cap; mirrors existing sibling style.
2. (Suggestion, logic_error) workpad.py:4727-4738 — next(...) inspects only the first matching row, so a duplicated extension row (first ticked, later unticked) fails open. Unlikely input; rows are single-sourced and reconciled.
3. (Suggestion, other) workpad.py:4739-4745 — note detection not anchored to the '- HH:MM:SS —' note shape; documented design choice, small blast radius.
4. (Suggestion, test_gap) test_python_scripts.py:99-105 — no test for a note outside ## Progress (fails closed).
5. (Suggestion, test_gap) test_python_scripts.py:82-96 — no ordering test vs the AC hard-fail (both refuse Complete anyway).

No corroboration across agents (all single-source); all flagged for scrutiny per single-source rule but none merge-blocking.

## Assessment
The change is correct against all four ACs and the pre-#1462 legacy-workpad gotcha, verified against the shipped code by multiple agents. It is fail-closed (raise-before-PATCH, AC4 confirms (1, None)), single-sources the row set through `_EXTENSION_ROWS`, correctly restores/re-installs the module-load bypass around the dedicated test block, and its docstring/prose/changeset claims are truthful against HEAD. The five Suggestions are minor polish and optional edge-case coverage; none blocks merge. APPROVE with notes.
